scope: iOS weekly poster auto-present after 08:00 local on the page service date

behaviour.rule: The verified poster presents itself once per unseen page/locale/release from 08:00 device-local time on the page's own service date.
triggers: completion of the app-scoped foreground announcement refresh
behaviour.repeat: A seen receipt suppresses the same release; the manual card and reopen entry stay available.

coreTests.newSuite: WeeklyPosterScheduleTests (5 cases: 08:00 boundary, earlier/later service dates, device time zone, exact DST instants, malformed dates)

uiTests.firstRound: Two pending-fixture tests failed because the new launch argument did not also request the weekly-update fixture; fixed the argument pair and reran all four.

nonBlockingFindingsAddressed: foreground return presented from un-refreshed state; the app-scoped refresh now publishes a revision that re-evaluates the offer
one-shot/locale races; presentation refuses a stale-language announcement and a failed initial load no longer enables a language-switch popup
App Store and live poster capture flows accept an already-presented sheet
notAddressed: app left open across 08:00 does not auto-open until the next launch/foreground return (intended: 'opening the app')
push-tap versus auto-present ordering remains unverified on a device

productionBinding.note: Announcement, release package and poster PNG bytes were re-verified against production hosting in the push preflight; this App build only adds the local-time gate and presentation trigger.

notVerified: real-device install of a build containing this change
production-origin App build on a physical device
push notification device display and tap
live poster smoke (TONGXING_LIVE_POSTER_SMOKE) and App Store capture flows (Release, env-gated)
notes: The installed store/beta App does not contain this commit, so it will keep the manual card until a new build is distributed. The scheduled 2026-11-01 08:00 America/Los_Angeles push send is recorded separately.
